Reads the caller name shown by Truecaller/the in-call UI during an incoming call, for SpamBlok\'s own caller-ID overlay. This build only logs locally — it stores and sends nothing.

Phase 2 — number + our own banner

SpamBlok gets the incoming NUMBER directly from the system (as the call screener), reads the caller NAME off the in-call UI/Truecaller overlay (Phase 1), and shows both in SpamBlok's own banner while the phone rings.

Setup (all three needed):
1. Enable "SpamBlok Banner Reader" in Accessibility Settings.
2. Grant "Display over other apps" so SpamBlok can show its banner.
3. Set SpamBlok as the system call-screening app.

Then call this phone from another number and watch for SpamBlok's banner at the top of the screen while it rings. Nothing is uploaded — everything stays on-device.
